idea-plugin.name: Minimax MCP
idea-plugin.description:
MiniMax H3 multimodal video generation via Model Context Protocol (MCP).

This plugin helps you set up the MiniMax H3 MCP server with JetBrains AI Assistant. Once configured, AI Assistant can generate videos from text, multiple images, and audio guidance through Ace Data Cloud.

Features

  • 7 AI Tools — Generate videos from text, images, and audio guidance
  • Easy Setup — One-click copy MCP configuration for AI Assistant
  • Dual Mode — STDIO (local) and HTTP (remote) server support
  • Token Management — Store API token securely in IDE settings

Available Tools

  • Text to Video — Create videos from text prompts
  • Multi-Image Video — Generate from one to nine reference images
  • Audio-Guided Video — Guide motion with one to three audio references
  • Task Tracking — Monitor generation progress and retrieve results

Quick Start

  1. Install this plugin
  2. Open Settings → Tools → Minimax MCP
  3. Enter your Ace Data Cloud API token
  4. Click Copy Config and paste into Settings → Tools → AI Assistant → MCP

Requires uv (Python package runner) for STDIO mode, or use HTTP mode for zero-install remote access.
